title: CatFORGE reproducibility package
description: Code, data and stored results that regenerate every figure, table and number in the Results of the manuscript describing CatFORGE, a browser-based platform for data-guided, cost-aware catalyst design: the synthetic-data augmentation benchmark (DRM, water-gas shift and oxidative coupling of methane literature compilations held out by publication, reference or element set), the held-out benchmark of the platform's predictor against ten baselines, SHAP explanations, cost-aware candidate ranking and laboratory comparisons. Includes the evaluated versions of the platform's prediction, optimization and synthesis modules. One command (python reproduce.py --figures --check) regenerates the figures and checks every reported number. The web interface of the platform is not included.
